cards.title: Ever My Heart Rises
cards.gameText: Tale. When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to discard the top 5 cards of your draw deck.

cards.title: From the Armory
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make that Dwarf unable to take wounds.
cards.lore: “‘It's a bit tight around the chest.'”

cards.title: Erethon
cards.subtitle: Naith Lieutenant
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Erethon bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +1 and damage +1, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: At close range, Erethón's accuracy is uncanny.

cards.title: Fereveldir
cards.subtitle: Son of Thandronen
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Fereveldir and discard an [ELVEN] token from your condition to wound a minion Fereveldir is skirmishing.
cards.lore: Thandronen's sons patrol the borders of Lórien together.

cards.title: Ferevellon
cards.subtitle: Son of Thandronen
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Ferevellon to make a minion skirmishing him strength -2.
cards.lore: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.

cards.title: Haldir
cards.subtitle: Emissary of the Galadhrim
cards.gameText: Valiant. While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2. Regroup: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.
cards.lore: “‘In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor – we come to honor that allegiance.'”

cards.title: Legolas
cards.subtitle: Dauntless Hunter
cards.gameText: Archer. Each time a Shadow event or Shadow condition is played, remove (1) for each unbound Hobbit you can spot (limit (2)).
cards.lore: “‘They are far, far away.... I know in my heart that they have not rested this night.'”

cards.title: Lorien Guardian
cards.gameText: Valiant. Regroup: Exert this companion to make a Shadow player wound a minion.
cards.lore: Haldir's Elven bowmen were experienced defenders of the borders of the Golden Wood

cards.title: Lorien Swordsman
cards.gameText: Valiant. Each minion skirmishing this companion is strength -2 for each wound on that minion.
cards.lore: Long, curved Elven steel cut down Uruks already weakened by Elven arrows.

cards.title: Ordulus
cards.subtitle: Young Warrior
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. The twilight cost of each ranged weapon played on Ordulus is -1.
cards.lore: Ordulus always has an arrow nocked and a full quiver too.

cards.title: Pengedhel
cards.subtitle: Naith Warrior
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Pengedhel bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +2 and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: Pengedhel can wield an arrow like a short spear.

cards.title: Thandronen
cards.subtitle: Veteran Protector
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Thandronen to discard a minion stacked on a condition or stacked on a site.
cards.lore: The twin sons of Thandronen marched with their father to defend Helm's Deep.

cards.title: Thonnas
cards.subtitle: Naith Captain
cards.gameText: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Thonnas bears a ranged weapon, each minion skirmishing him is strength -2 and Thonnas does not add to the fellowship archery total.
cards.lore: Elves of Lórien hone their knife-work fighting Goblin raiders.

cards.title: Grown Suddenly Tall
cards.gameText: Spell.\If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, spot Gandalf to hinder all conditions.  Add (1) for each Shadow condition hindered (limit (5)).
cards.lore: “His hood and grey rags were flung away. His white garments shone.”

cards.title: Keep Your Forked Tongue
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot Gandalf and 3 twilight tokens to make a companion who has the Gandalf signet unable to take wounds.
cards.lore: “‘A witless worm you have become.'”

cards.title: Long I Fell
cards.gameText: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make him unable to take wounds. Any Shadow player may make you wound a minion to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘His fire was about me. I was burned.'”

cards.title: Roll of Thunder
cards.gameText: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or hinder a Shadow artifact.
cards.lore: “‘I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'”

cards.title: Come Down
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: If you can spot an [ISENGARD] minion, spot a fortification. Make the Free Peoples player distribute X + 1 wounds among your [ISENGARD] minions, where X is its twilight cost. Discard that fortification. Archery: Spot 2 [ISENGARD] archers to make allies take wounds from archery fire instead of companions.
cards.lore: “‘We are the fighting Uruk-hai.... Bring out your skulking king!'”

cards.title: Grima
cards.subtitle: Son of Galmod
cards.gameText: Lurker.\Each unbound companion or ally bearing a Shadow condition is strength -1.
cards.lore: “‘Did I not counsel you, lord, to forbid his staff?'”

cards.title: Grima
cards.subtitle: Wormtongue
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a weapon borne by an unbound companion (or all Free Peoples cards borne by that companion if they are bearing 3 or more cards).
cards.lore: “‘I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.'”

cards.title: Uruk Regular
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to play an Uruk-hai; its twilight cost is -1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot (limit -2).
cards.lore: “‘We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm.'”

cards.title: Southron Archer
cards.gameText: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control (limit +2).
cards.lore: “‘They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'”

cards.title: Fortress Never Fallen
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fortification. Each time a [ROHAN] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [ROHAN] token on this card. Regroup: Discard a Shadow condition for each [ROHAN] token here (limit 4). Discard this condition.
cards.lore: “‘...it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'”

cards.title: Herugrim
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'”

cards.title: Simbelmyne
cards.gameText: Spot 2 [ROHAN] Men (or 1 valiant [ROHAN] Man) to play a [ROHAN] character or [ROHAN] item from your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called... for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'”

cards.title: Get On and Get Away
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits (or Smeagol) and add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).
cards.lore: “‘The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

cards.title: Cavern Entrance
cards.gameText: At the start of each skirmish, you may exert your character in that skirmish to prevent special abilities being used.
